title: Signed exchange from Hom tensor to Hom of tensor
statement: Let Y be a scheme in universe t and R a commutative ring sheaf in universe max(u,t+1) on its pro-etale site. For arbitrary unbounded complexes P,I,Q of R-module sheaves, there exists a chain map Hom(P,I) tensor Q to Hom(P,I tensor Q). On local homogeneous sections v,z,x in degrees a,b,p its evaluation is (-1)^(bp) times v(x) tensor z, with the canonical degree transport. The signed formula is exactly IsSignedHomTensor of [lem-sf-two-term-free-hom-tensor-components]. No resolutions, flatness, injectivity or coefficient reduction are assumed.

proof.text: Use the normalized chain tensor-Hom equivalences for (Hom(P,I),P,I) and (Hom(P,I) tensor Q,P,I tensor Q). Apply the inverse of the first to the identity to obtain evaluation. Apply the tensor-evaluation interchange theorem and then the second equivalence to obtain the desired signed map.

The normalized equivalence formula and the pure-section interchange formula identify evaluation of the curried map with the required (-1)^(bp) expression. The inverse-image identity identifies evaluation with v(x); the canonical tensor generator transport gives the exact degree transport of IsSignedHomTensor.

proof_origin.place: paragraphs 1-2; coefficient, chain-map and normalization steps separated
